subject: english
question:
**Direction: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Very few animals / was / as faithful as / the dog.
solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **"was."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The subject **"Very few animals"** is plural, so the verb should also be plural.
 
• **"Was"** is a singular helping verb, so it is incorrect.
 
• The correct verb should be **"were."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 

**Correct sentence**: *Very few animals **were**__ as faithful as the dog.*
